Panel.Title: Barometer
Panel.Hint: How you feel, any time. Click again to withdraw your answer.

Summary.Title: Barometer — summary
Summary.PolarizedHint: Players are reporting both extremes at once: the average is meaningless here.
Summary.FlushHint: Clears every value, yours and the players'.
Summary.FlushConfirm: Reset the barometer for the whole table?

GmVotes.Name: GM also gets the palette
GmVotes.Hint: Shows the voting palette to the GM. Their value is then counted in the summary.

PlayersSeeSummary.Name: Players may open the summary
PlayersSeeSummary.Hint: Grants players access to the same anonymized summary as the GM.

MinRespondents.Name: Minimum answers threshold
MinRespondents.Hint: Below this number of answers, an axis stays hidden. Protects anonymity at small tables.

RevealDelay.Name: Reveal delay (seconds)
RevealDelay.Hint: Maximum random delay before a change reaches the GM — the alert dot and the open summary alike. 0 = real time. Raising it breaks the link between a change and whatever was happening at that moment. Nothing is lost, only its timing is blurred.

AutoOpen.Name: Open the palette on login
AutoOpen.Hint: The palette shows up automatically when the world loads.

Axes.Name: Barometer axes
Axes.Hint: Labels, icons and nature of each axis.
Axes.Label: Configure axes
Axes.Title: Barometer axes
Axes.EditorIntro: Add, remove or reorder the axes your table answers on. Changes apply at once; answers on axes you keep are preserved.
Axes.FreeIcon: Or paste any emoji, then Enter
Axes.KindHint: Bipolar: both ends are warnings and the middle is the sweet spot (pace, dosage). Ordinal: the right end is the good one (fun).
Axes.AdvancedHint: While this section is open, its contents take precedence over the fields above when saving.
Axes.EditorHint: One object per axis. "kind" is either "bipolar" (the optimum sits in the middle: pace, dosage) or "ordinal" (the optimum sits on the right: fun). The three options must carry the values -1, 0 and 1. A label may be a translation key or plain text.
Axes.NeedsName: Every axis needs a name before this can be saved.

Notify.NoGM: No GM connected: your setting will be sent as soon as one connects.

Validation.Root: The root must be a non-empty array.
Validation.BadId: Axis id '{id}' must be {max} characters or fewer, letters, digits, - and _ only.
Validation.ForbiddenId: '{id}' cannot be used as an axis id.
Validation.BadLabel: Axis '{id}' needs a label of {max} characters or fewer.
Validation.BadValues: The options of axis '{id}' must carry the values -1, 0 and 1.
Validation.OptionLabel: An option of axis '{id}' has a label longer than {max} characters.
Validation.OptionIcon: An option of axis '{id}' has an icon longer than {max} characters.
